question: Where do the halfer's 1/2 and the thirder's 1/3 come from when the same Sleeping Beauty experiment is run thousands of times?
finding: In 101,000 simulated experiments the coin landed heads in 50.03% of experiments but only 33.36% of awakenings came after heads, and a ticket on heads priced at 0.40 made 0.10 per experiment sold once per experiment and lost 0.10 per experiment sold at every awakening.
limit: The simulation shows what each position counts, not which count Beauty's credence should follow.
